title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: soundboard master cassette-> cassette-> DAT-> CDR-> .WAV-> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a solid 1982 Minnesota show with a smoky Space jam and Brent’s keyboards, though Phil’s bass is buried in the mix.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality, delivering a well‑played early‑80s performance that many fans call “smokin’”. Highlights include an eleven‑beat Space segment and strong Brent work, while the mix downplays Phil’s bass. Overall the show feels energetic and representative of 1982 Dead magic despite the slight bass‑mix issue.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 4‑5 stars, emphasizing strong musical performance and excellent soundboard clarity; only a minor mix complaint lowers the rating slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal clear overall sound; however Phil’s bass is noticeably low in the mix for some listeners.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid, well‑structured set typical of early‑80s Dead shows; transitions flow smoothly and the energy stays high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Strong accents noted during the Space jam; solid guitar work throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is buried in the mix, leading some reviewers to wish for more Lesh presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are highlighted as rounding into form and adding to the early‑80s vibe.
